jobs.description:
**Why Join Resmed**

At Resmed, your work helps enable better customer experiences, smarter decision-making, and more effective digital and marketing capabilities across a global organisation. Youll collaborate with teams spanning Marketing, Data, Product, Analytics, and Technology while contributing to enterprise-scale initiatives that drive innovation, operational excellence, and business performance. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with data, and helping organisations maximise the value of their technology investments, youll find meaningful opportunities to grow and make an impact at Resmed.

  

**Let’s talk about the team**

As a **Business Analyst – Marketing Solutions**, you will help shape how marketing technology, data, and digital capabilities deliver value across Resmed. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Data, Product, Digital, Analytics, and Technology teams, you’ll turn business needs into scalable, compliant, and outcome-focused solutions. Your work will support customer engagement, campaign performance, product content quality, search experiences, digital experiences, and data-driven decision-making across a complex global marketing ecosystem. This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-wide initiatives while partnering with stakeholders across APAC, EMEA, and AMER.

  

**Let’s talk about the role**

* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to capture, analyse and document requirements.
* Translate requirements into user stories, process flows, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.
* Support the delivery and optimisation of key marketing technology platforms including CDP, CRM, Marketing Automation, CMS, DAM, PXM, DXP and Enterprise Search.
* Analyse marketing, customer and product data to identify opportunities, risks and improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering, Analytics and Technology teams to support reporting, integrations, data quality and governance.
* Support project planning, UAT, change management, adoption activities and ongoing platform improvements.
* Contribute to AI and automation initiatives that improve operations and customer experiences.
* Prepare documentation, stakeholder updates and delivery status reports using Jira and Confluence.

  

**Let’s talk about you**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Marketing Technology, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
* 5-7 years' experience in Business Analysis, Marketing Technology, Digital Platforms, Data Platforms or Technology Delivery.
* Experience working on MarTech, digital transformation, enterprise application or data-driven initiatives.
* Strong business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process mapping and stakeholder management.
* Understanding of marketing operations, customer engagement, marketing data and digital experiences.
* Experience analysing data, defining reporting requirements, supporting KPI development, and collaborating with Data Engineering and Analytics teams.
* Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global, cross-functional teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**What the role owns**

Embedded finance strategy  - Own and evolve the financial services roadmap, starting with embedded credit and extending to payments and adjacent products as customer need, economics and regulatory readiness allow.

Customer and use-case discovery  - Identify high-potential financing needs across fleet operators, system integrators, garages, marketplace sellers and vehicle owners. Define ideal customer profiles and prioritise use cases on need, economics and feasibility.

Lender and funding partnerships  - Work with banks, NBFCs and fintech partners to match lender appetite with customer segments on Org and partner platforms. Build multi-lender capability so the business does not depend on one funding source.

Financial product structuring  - Co-create products with lenders: credit limits, tenure, repayment constructs, transaction flows, eligibility criteria, pricing and customer propositions.

Programme and scheme design - Design financing schemes, incentives, bundles and activation programmes that drive adoption and repeat utilisation.

Platform partnerships  - Work with mobility and ecosystem platforms to find transaction flows where financial products can be embedded, and agree operating and commercial models that work for both sides.

Digital product and infrastructure - Define the journeys and architecture for onboarding, consent, KYC and KYB, lender routing, credit decisioning, checkout, disbursement, settlement, repayment visibility and reconciliation.

Technology service provider management  - Work with lending service and technology providers to build reusable lender integrations and embedded journeys.

Data and underwriting enablement - Convert consented mobility and transaction data into lender-consumable signals, such as fleet utilisation, running distance, garage throughput and purchase consistency. Contribute to a scoring and borrower-profiling approach together with the Identity Resolution and Consent Engine product lead.

Regulatory and governance coordination  - Work with Legal, Compliance and Finance to put the right referral, DSA, LSP or other operating constructs in place, and build data protection and consent requirements into the product from the start.

jobs.title: Community and Brand Lead
jobs.description:
**Note:** Tarlan is recruiting a Community and Brand Lead for Bindbee, an Software Infrastructure SaaS startup. Tarlan is a recruiting firm managing this search.

  

**About Bindbee**

Bindbee is a unified API for HR, payroll and benefits systems. Companies building benefits, HR and insurance software connect once instead of building and maintaining separate integrations with Workday, ADP, UKG, Paycom and 110+ other systems.

  

Its customers are US companies: benefits administrators, TPAs, ICHRA platforms, benefits navigation apps and HR-tech products. Teams like ThrivePass, Newfront and Healthee run on Bindbee. The company is SOC 2, ISO, GDPR and HIPAA compliant.

  

Bindbee is profitable, serves 100+ customers, and about one in three customers refers a new one. This role turns that existing advocacy into something built deliberately.

  

**The role**

Youll build two things: a brand buyers recognize and a community they want to be part of. Both are judged on whether the right buyers know Bindbee and whether they bring in pipeline.

  

There is no community like this in Bindbees market today. The people running benefits, payroll and HR data at TPAs, benefits platforms and HR-tech companies lack a shared place to learn from each other. Youll decide who it serves, what it offers and why people would show up. Nothing is handed to you.

  

The community must help members first. It cannot be a Bindbee sales channel with a different name. Trust, recognition and peer referrals are what create pipeline.

  

This is a **hands-on individual contributor role**. You set the direction and do the work: posts, invites, calls, events and follow-ups.

  

**What youll do**

* **Build the brand and find the audience.** Own Bindbees presence on LinkedIn, X and wherever its buyers spend time. Shape its voice and content, map the groups, newsletters, podcasts, events and creators buyers follow, and bring Bindbee into those conversations.
* **Design and launch the community.** Define who it serves, what members gain, where it lives and how they join. Recruit the first members through customers, partners and existing networks, then expand into the wider market.
* **Run programming people return for.** Organize expert sessions, conversations across member segments, AMAs, a research newsletter and virtual events. Bring trusted operators, analysts and creators in as guests, co-hosts and collaborators.
* **Turn trust into measurable pipeline.** Identify members with real integration needs and hand them to sales with context. Track referrals, meetings, community growth and activity, and brand reach and engagement among ideal customers.
* **Work with the team.** Pull stories from customers, founders, sales and product, and share what you hear from the market.

  

**Who you are**

* **You have built a community from zero.** You started it, found the first members and got people to returnnot just joined or moderated an existing one.
* **You have grown a B2B brand organically.** You built a company or founders following on LinkedIn or X without paid ads and can show what worked.
* **You balance member trust with business outcomes.** You understand that a community must give before it gets and can explain how your work generated business while protecting that trust. You care about relevant awareness and meetings, beyond likes and follower counts.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  

At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.

In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.

We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.

Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules.

  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities**  

Your Daily Work: The 9 Core Areas

Your job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day:

  Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.  
  A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.  
  Why do we do thisBecause it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"-that document becomes your team's guide.

jobs.title: Product Manager, UK Practice Software
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Thousands of UK accountancy practices rely on our software every day to run their firms, serve their clients and meet their compliance obligations. As Product Manager, you will own part of that portfolio and help take it from a set of well-run products to a connected, AI-enabled platform that practices and partners can build on. This is a build-and-converge mandate, not a maintenance role.
  
  
The Product Manager role is changing. AI is changing the way we work: the time from idea to working software is shrinking, prototyping is moving towards real development with tools like Claude Code, and the lines between product, engineering and design are blurring. The successful candidate will be flexible and willing to lean into that change, and will partner heavily with engineering and design, shaping, prototyping and building alongside them rather than handing over documents.
  
  
You will use the latest AI tools to move from idea to validated prototype faster than traditional product management allows, in a team that treats AI as part of its everyday toolkit.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Practices are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
* Clients expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive finished work.
* Document data extraction, preparation and review are going AI-native, and practices are adopting agentic tools now.
* Practices increasingly want open APIs, so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
* Regulatory change, such as Making Tax Digital, keeps raising the bar for reliability at filing peaks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision and roadmap. Balance customer needs, regulatory change and commercial priorities into a clear, evidence-based plan, and own the commercially consequential decisions that follow from it.
* Deliver the portfolio, season over season. Own your products end to end, at the reliability and scale that filing deadlines and compliance peaks demand.
* Converge products without disrupting customers. Bring overlapping products and capabilities together into one connected experience for every practice and client, and migrate existing customers without breaking what they rely on.
* Componentise the portfolio. Turn each part of the product into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the practice workflow and the wider platform, rather than locked inside a single application.
* Open the platform through APIs and orchestration. Expand the API surface (open APIs, events and integrations) as a first-class capability, so practices and partners embed our products in their own portals and workflows, and AI agents and partner systems can coordinate work programmatically.
* Bring agentic, AI-driven workflows to practices. Work with the platform team to bring AI-driven extraction, preparation and review into the product experience, so more of the work shifts from practice staff to the platform while the practice stays in control.
* Turn customer problems into well-defined solutions. Use AI tools to turn customer problems into clear, testable requirements that engineering and design can build from with confidence, in whatever form works best for the team.
* Prototype early, then build. Use Claude Code or similar tools to build working prototypes that test ideas with customers and stakeholders before significant engineering investment is made

**Description**

At the International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

Private sector financial development is essential to the promotion of successful and sustainable economies in low- and middle-income countries around the world. Infrastructure plays a key role in sustained economic growth by providing critical public services to the citizens in a country as well as a platform for efficient operation of businesses that create jobs. The private sector plays an increasingly important role in the financing and delivery of infrastructure and public services, including through Corporate Finance Services.

IFC’s transaction advisory services department (CTA) is housed in the World Bank Group’s Client’s and Products Vice Presidency (CCPVP) and consists of two business lines:

* PPP Transaction Advisory (C3P) offers transaction advisory services to governments design, structure PPP transactions in infrastructure to help client governments partner with the private sector to deliver affordable and high-quality infrastructure.
* Corporate Finance Services (CFS) has three key product offerings: (1) M&A Advisory: supporting investment departments in business development and creating investment opportunities; (2) Equity Mobilization Program (EMP): supporting third party equity mobilization alongside IFC investment; (3) Asset monetization involving listed or listing public entities.

CTA has mobilized $6.6B for FY25 which translates into around 17% of IFC’s total core mobilization, of which CFS mobilized over $1.5B of this amount. The department is expected to continue playing a leading role in mobilizing private capital for the WBG.

CFS is seeking a (Senior) Investment Officer with strong M&A experience to help support the execution of our business strategy in the Middle East, Turkey and Central Asia Region. The position will be based in Dubai, UAE and will report to the Global Manager, CFS. The (Senior) Investment Officer will support the CFS regional teams with global capacity, with the objective of facilitating business development and executing transactions

The Senior Manager- Contracts is responsible for managing the complete contract & cost lifecycle for real estate development projects, including budget preparations, tendering, contract administration, commercial negotiations, claims management, billing works and vendor performance. jobs.description:
**Role:** **Asset Management Associate**  
**Experience Range:** 3 to 5years (minimum 3years experience is mandatory)  
**Work Location:** Bangalore (Bellandur)  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid; 4days work from office  
**Shift Timing:** 12pm to 9:30PM IST

  

We are partnering with one of our key clients and they are seeking an analytical professional to support the ongoing asset management of residential A&D, ADC, and homebuilder lending facilities. The role will focus on individual loan and project performance, borrower requests, credit actions, and the resolution of asset-level matters following loan closing.

The ideal candidate will have strong real estate credit and asset-management skills, a solid understanding of residential development and homebuilder finance, and the ability to evaluate changing circumstances, identify asset-level risks, and recommend appropriate actions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Loan Closing-

* Coordinate loan closings with borrowers, Credit, title companies, and the closing team/legal counsel.
* Review loan documents and credit approvals to confirm closing terms match approved conditions.
* Track and collect closing conditions and required documents, including organizational documents, insurance, title, surveys, appraisals, and guaranties, and confirm all conditions are met and approvals received before funding.
* Coordinate initial funding and confirm wire instructions and funds flow.
* Board newly closed loans in the servicing and portfolio management systems and hand off loan details to the servicer.

Portfolio and Construction Monitoring-

* Manage a portfolio of homebuilder and residential development loans, evaluate performance against approved business plans, loan terms, and transaction expectations, and maintain accurate loan and borrower information in the servicing and portfolio management systems.
* Review monthly builder inventory reports, monitor home starts, completions, closings, cancellations, and sales pace, and reconcile them against current BHS reporting.
* Track project progress, construction milestones, phasing, and lot development activity against approved budgets and timelines.
* Coordinate property inspections, field reviews, and third-party reports, and evaluate material findings affecting the financed project or collateral.

Borrowing Base and Collateral Management-

* Review borrowing base certificates and collateral reports and monitor collateral availability and borrowing capacity.
* Verify collateral eligibility and valuation requirements and review appraisals and valuation updates.
* Coordinate collateral releases and lot takedowns and keep collateral records accurate and current.

Borrower Compliance, Extensions, and Credit Actions-

* Monitor borrower compliance with loan requirements, including covenants, reporting requirements, insurance coverage, permits, licenses, and other contractual requirements.
* Identify breaches of loan terms and covenants, project deviations, or other emerging concerns, make sure the RM/UW is aware, and recommend appropriate solutions or risk mitigants.
* Review and track extension conditions, work with borrowers to meet them before maturity, and prepare extension recommendation packages for approval.
* Evaluate and coordinate waivers, consents, modifications, renewals, amendments, and other post-closing borrower requests, and prepare recommendations for approval.
* Review and interpret loan agreements, guaranties, and related credit doc

jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description:
**The Role**
India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.
  
  
You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.
  
  
As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.
  
  
Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.
* Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.
* Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.
* The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.
* Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.
* The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.
* The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

**Who You Are**

* 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.
* Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.
* Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.
* A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.
* A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance

Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.

We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

**Our Core Commitments — What We Live By**

Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

* Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
* Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
* Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

**Perks of Joining Our Team**

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. While we have all the tools to work remotely, we value the purpose and benefits of in-person connections so expect regular team off-sites. We also offer unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

As the Head of APAC, you will be the ultimate executive responsible for driving the commercial expansion, strategic growth, product launches, and operational optimization of the Company across the Asia-Pacific region. You will hold full accountability and responsibility for APAC growth targets, taking end-to-end ownership of Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. You will build the partner network, commercial deals, and local operational engines needed to launch, scale, and optimize them rapidly. This role requires an ambitious commercial mindset, exceptional matrix leadership capabilities, and a deep understanding of cross-border financial markets.

to lead the performance, roadmap, execution, and player experience of YallaPlay’s game portfolio.

jobs.description:
**About Aspora**
People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.
  
  
Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.
  
  
We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.
  
  
**About The Role**
People build lives across borders, and Aspora helps the Indian diaspora send money home and grow wealth in India. Growth here is won in a user’s first three months: a friend’s referral, a first transfer, a return next month. This role exists to turn that journey into a growth engine that compounds with every new cohort. You will own growth for our product, working closely with design, engineering, data and our CLM team.
  
  
You decide which bets to make, how big they should be, and when to stop one that isn’t working. What you build will shape how fast Aspora grows, and the growth playbook we take into every new market
  
  
Location
  
  
In Office || Bangalore
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* This is a role with full ownership of the journey at the heart of Aspora’s core business.
* Diagnose where growth leaks. Go deep into funnels on every launch and older bet, and publish insights the whole team acts on.
* Own the number and the path. Check the numbers daily, hold a clear view on opportunity areas, and open new growth threads.
* Grow referral and activation. Ship reward constructs and product bets that bring more users in and get them to a first transfer.
* Make new users stay. Lift retention in the first three months by turning a first transfer into a monthly habit.
* Size every bet to matter. Set the payback before launch, read the result honestly, and call it early when a bet isn’t working.
* Build trust after every transfer. Shape the post-transfer experience so customers feel informed and in control, even when timing slips.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
You’re not someone who measures a quarter by features shipped. You measure it by the number you moved, and you can show exactly how.
  
  

* You’ve moved a growth number. You owned an acquisition, activation or retention metric in a consumer app and can walk through what moved it.
* You live in the data. You write your own SQL or analytics queries and read an experiment properly: control groups, sample checks, significance.
* You’ve run rewards with a payback. You designed referral, cashback or incentive programmes with the unit economics worked out before launch.
* You ship experiments end to end. Hypothesis, launch, readout and the next iteration, more than once, on dates you agreed and kept.
* You go to the source. You’ve turned user calls, session replays or research into a product decision that changed what shipped.
* You know consumer products. You’ve built product or growth at a consumer app, and Indian consumer fintech experience is a strong plus.
* You own the goal, not the task. You hold the number, the path to it and the next thread to pull, without waiting to be asked.
* Most importantly, you want a number that is clearly your

We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

jobs.title: Senior Call Center Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description -**

Lead, organize and manage the Call Centre Sales business across all products to ensure achievement of defined business targets. Drive sales conversion, E2E journey, productivity, profitability, quality, and customer experience through tele-sales channels. Develop sales strategies, build team capabilities, optimize operating costs, and leverage technology and analytics to maximize call center contribution to overall business objectives while maintaining portfolio quality and compliance with organizational policies and guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities -**

**1. Business and Sales Planning**

* Develop annual and periodic sales plans for call center business across all products.
* Forecast sales opportunities, inbound and outbound business volumes, and manpower requirements based on business projections.
* Cascade sales targets across teams and monitor achievement through regular reviews.
* Drive business growth through End to End journey fulfilment and lead conversion strategies.
* Present business performance, productivity, profitability, and operational metrics to senior leadership for review and strategic direction.

**2. P&L Management**

* Own and manage overall Call Center Sales P&L.
* Review revenue, cost, productivity, technology expenses, manpower costs, incentive payouts, and vendor spend.
* Partner with Finance and Business leaders to improve operating efficiencies and profitability.
* Drive initiatives to optimize cost per acquisition, cost per lead, and cost per conversion.
* Identify opportunities for automation and productivity improvements to improve operating leverage.

**3. Sales Funnel and Lead Management**

* Work with Analytics, BIU, Marketing, Digital, and Product teams to enhance lead quality and customer targeting.
* Monitor lead allocation, lead aging, conversion ratios, contact ability, and sales effectiveness.
* Develop customer segmentation strategies and differentiated sales propositions to improve campaign outcomes.

**4. Customer Acquisition and Conversion**

* Drive sales performance across digital-assisted, inbound and outbound,
* Monitor conversion rates at every stage of the sales funnel and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure achievement of product-wise and channel-wise business targets.
* Enhance customer experience through simplified sales processes and reduced turnaround times.
* Continuously improve scripts, pitches, and sales methodologies to improve conversion effectiveness.

**5. Process Excellence and Capability Enhancement**

* Drive continuous improvement in sales processes, customer journeys, and team productivity.
* Partner with Product, Technology, Operations, and COE teams to develop new capabilities and automation solutions.
* Review operational bottlenecks and implement corrective measures.
* Champion adoption of new technologies, AI-enabled solutions, dialer systems, CRM enhancements, and digital sales tools.
* Ensure scalability of processes to support future business growth.

**6. Vendor and Partner Management**

* Manage relationships with telephony partners, technology vendors, staffing agencies, lead providers, and outsourced call center partners.
* Evaluate and onboard vendors based on business needs and service standards.
* Lead commercial negotiations and contract discussions.
* Conduct periodic business reviews to assess quality, productivity, compliance, and cost effectiveness.
* Ensure vendors adhere to organizational and regulatory requirements.

**Chief Finance and Operating Officer**

The Foundation is committed to advancing social and economic mobility for India’s most underserved communities, with a sustained focus on women, children, and youth. The Foundation does this through high-impact, scalable interventions across education, public health, and livelihoods, addressing multidimensional barriers to enable individuals to participate fully in India’s growth story. Founded two decades ago in the aftermath of the devastating Gujarat earthquake as a historic humanitarian initiative by then Prime Minister of India, Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ji, and U.S. President Mr. Bill Clinton, it has served 20.47 million lives across 35 States and Union Territories of India.

Registered as a Trust in India with an independent Board of Trustees, it adheres to rigorous financial and governance standards, ensuring transparency, accountability, and the responsible stewardship of resources. This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. jobs.title: Sr Applied Scientist - Semantics
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**   

AuxoAI is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to design and deploy structured knowledge systems that enable reliable, schema-grounded AI and agent reasoning. This role sits at the intersection of large language models, knowledge graphs, semantic architectures, and hybrid retrieval systems. The ideal candidate will build systems that transform unstructured data into structured knowledge representations, enforce semantic constraints, and enable hybrid symbolic-neural reasoning in production environments. You will play a key role in designing scalable semantic infrastructures that support advanced AI use cases such as GraphRAG pipelines, structured extraction, and agent reasoning workflows. You will work on problems where existing architectures may not be sufficient and will experiment with new approaches that combine machine learning, knowledge graphs, semantic constraints, and classical AI techniques to build reliable, production-grade systems. Location - Mumbai / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurgaon (Hybrid - 3 Days a week in Office)

  
  
**Responsibilities**   

* Design schema-guided information extraction systems using zero-shot and few-shot structured prompting, constrained decoding approaches such as JSON schema enforcement or grammar-based decoding, and function-calling or tool-driven extraction techniques.
* Develop recursive or multi-stage extraction pipelines capable of handling nested entities, hierarchical structures, and cross-document relationships.
* Build ontology-driven systems using frameworks such as LinkML, OWL, SHACL, or similar schema modeling tools, and implement knowledge representations using RDF triples or labeled property graphs.
* Design and optimize entity resolution algorithms using techniques such as blocking strategies, embedding similarity, and rule-based matching.
* Develop ontology alignment techniques and graph embedding models such as Node2Vec or TransE-style approaches where appropriate.
* Design hybrid retrieval architectures combining dense vector retrieval, sparse retrieval techniques, and graph traversal algorithms such as BFS, DFS, path ranking, and neighborhood expansion.
* Build validation systems that enforce schema conformance, detect semantic inconsistencies, and reduce hallucinated or invalid structured outputs.
* Integrate structured knowledge systems into GraphRAG pipelines, agent planning frameworks, and tool-selection workflows.
* Deliver production-grade semantic systems with clear targets for latency, scalability, reliability, and data integrity.

  
  
**Requirements**   

* 5+ years of experience building production AI or machine learning systems.
* Strong experience designing and implementing knowledge graphs or ontology-driven architectures.
* Hands-on experience implementing structured extraction techniques, including grammar-constrained decoding, JSON schema enforcement, or AST-style parsing approaches.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
**Job description**

As a Sales Manager you will evaluate sales opportunities in multiple domains like BFSI, Telecom etc. Your exposure to Solution Sales/ Consulting environment or financial services will differentiate you from the rest.

You will sit within our Consumer services business, one of our four Global Business Lines. We create credit reports by collecting and analyzing credit histories – sorting through data about the credit people applied for, whether their applications were successful, and how they paid the credit back. We share this information with businesses so they can calculate a credit decision, usually using a credit score. This score predicts how likely people are to pay back what they owe. This combination of data, scores and software allow businesses to make accurate, fair and quick credit decisions.

**What you’ll do (Job responsibilities for this role)**

**1. Business Development & Sales:**

* Identify and target prospective banking and NBFC clients, including digital lending platforms, housing finance companies, small finance banks, and other financial lending institutes
* Increase sales of Experian's products and services, such as Bureau Solutions, credit risk solutions, fraud prevention tools, analytics platforms, and decisioning systems.
* Develop a strategic sales plan to achieve revenue targets and expand our client base within the BFSI segment.

**2. Client Relationship Management:**

* Build long-term relationships with important decision-makers at client organizations.
* Be a trusted advisor by understanding client needs and recommending appropriate solutions.
* Collaborate with clients to address challenges related to risk management, regulatory compliance, and customer acquisition.

**3. Solution Selling:**

* Present Experian’s offerings in a compelling manner, showcasing how they address specific client challenges.
* Customise proposals, presentations, and pricing strategies to align with client goals
* Partner with our teams (example- product, analytics, and implementation) to ensure delivery of solutions.

**4. Market Intelligence & Strategy:**

* Monitor trends and developments in the BFSI industry to identify opportunities.
* Provide feedback to the product development team on market demands and latest technologies.
* Represent Experian at industry events, conferences, and forums to enhance brand visibility and network with potential clients.

**5. Reporting & Performance Management:**

* Maintain accurate records of sales activities, opportunities, and forecasts in the CRM system
* Track and report on main performance metrics, including revenue growth, client acquisition, and customer satisfaction
* Identify areas for improvement and implement strategies to increase sales processes.

**Qualifications**

**What you’ll need to bring along (Your prior experience)**

* You have about 4+ years of experience of in the
  **solution sales / consulting environment**
  or a financial services environment
* Experience with the BFSI ecosystem, including HFC's, SFB's and related domains.
* Experience with B2B sales in financial services, technology, or related industries.
* Ability to engage with senior partners.
* Demonstrated expertise in solution-based selling and account management.
* Ability to interpret data and drive insights for decision-making.
* Strong negotiation skills.

**Location: Pune**

Interested candidates share their CV to
**daylene.dias@experian.com**

jobs.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**
Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
You’ll analyze Treasury operations to design future-state models, support Kyriba solution design, and configure static data for Treasury processes. You’ll automate cash reconciliation, enable bank statement integration, set up Cash Position worksheets, and manage cash forecasting with ERP integration. Responsibilities include interfacing Kyriba with systems like ICD, FXALL, and Oracle, establishing cash pools, configuring payment workflows, and adding Chart of Accounts for accounting. You’ll also handle documentation, user guides, end-user training, and team coordination to ensure seamless Treasury operations.

* Payments formats – XML Pain, EDI822, MT101 etc.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate, energetic individual to join our Lending Services division. You will be part of team working for prestigious Loan Operations clients based on global geography.

  

Shift Tiimings - (Work from Office) US Shift (6:30 pm 3:30 am)

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

* Review loan request packages for completeness and accuracy using established underwriting and closing checklists.
* Validate supporting documentation and coordinate return of incomplete packages for correction.
* Submit complete loan packages to Underwriting and maintain workflow status through internal tracking tools.
* Log transactions, update pipeline reports and ensure accurate milestone tracking throughout the loan lifecycle.
* Initiate and track due diligence activities including entity documentation, ownership verification, KYC/CIP requirements, signer validation and collateral documentation.
* Prepare approval condition checklists and coordinate resolution of post-approval requirements.
* Monitor and track outstanding underwriting conditions, documentation exceptions and due diligence items through closing.
* Coordinate with Relationship Managers, Credit, Legal, Operations and clients to confirm closing dates, final loan terms, pricing structures and funding requirements.
* Prepare, review and organize loan documentation packages using LaserPro and related documentation systems.
* Conduct quality control reviews to ensure completeness, accuracy and compliance of all loan documentation prior to closing.
* Track executed documents, monitor outstanding signatures and facilitate timely completion of closing requirements.
* Prepare funding worksheets, payoff calculations, fee schedules and wire instruction packages.
* Initiate funding transactions and wire transfers through OnPoint or equivalent funding platforms while adhering to established controls and procedures.
* Prepare loan boarding packages and servicing documentation for post-closing handoff.
* Book and board loans in Signature or equivalent servicing systems and coordinate transition to servicing teams.
* Perform post-closing validation reviews to ensure critical system fields, financial terms and customer information are accurately captured.
* Track original executed documents, title policies, lien perfection requirements, UCC filings and other collateral-related documentation.
* Maintain ticklers, exception tracking logs, collateral monitoring records and follow-up workflows.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining complete documentation and evidentiary records.
* Prepare MIS, SLA, productivity, pipeline and exception management reports for management review.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support operational excellence initiatives across loan closing and servicing functions.
* Ensure compliance with bank policies, regulatory requirements, credit approvals and operational risk standards

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

* 8 to 12 + years of experience in Commercial Loan Closing, Loan Documentation.
* Experience working with LaserPro, Abrigo / Sageworks, or comparable documentation and servicing systems.
* Knowledge of KYC/CIP, entity documentation, collateral perfection, UCC filings and loan documentation requirements.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Program Manager to lead and oversee the delivery of our complex SD-Branch implementation projects. In this pivotal role, you will be the central point of contact, responsible for ensuring the successful planning, execution, and completion of SD-Branch projects from conception to operational handover.

Key Responsibilities

* End-to-End Program Leadership: Manage the entire lifecycle of multiple, concurrent SD-WAN deployment programs, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.
* Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary liaison between clients, internal engineering teams, security teams, and leadership. Provide regular, clear updates on program status, risks, and milestones.
* Technical Strategy & Planning: Develop and own the overall program plan, including technical requirements, resource allocation, risk mitigation strategies, and detailed rollout schedules.
* Security Integration: Leverage your deep security expertise to guide the integration of next-generation firewalls (specifically Fortigate or Cisco) into the SD-WAN architecture, ensuring compliance with security policies.
* Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify, track, and mitigate program risks and technical issues. Escalate critical concerns appropriately and drive them to resolution.
* Vendor & Resource Coordination: Coordinate with technology vendors (e.g., Cisco, Fortinet, VMware), carriers, and internal resources to ensure seamless project execution.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure all delivered solutions meet the defined technical, security, and performance standards. Oversee the creation and handoff of all project documentation.

Preferred candidate profile

Overall Experience: A minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in IT/Network program or project management, with a significant focus on network infrastructure.

Technical Expertise (Mandatory):

* Deep, hands-on technical knowledge of Routing & Switching (BGP, OSPF, MPLS) and Network Security principles.
* Hands-on experience configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting either Fortigate or Cisco Firewalls.
* Proven experience managing large-scale SD-WAN deployments (e.g., Cisco Viptela, VMware SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Silver Peak).

Program Management Skills:

* Expertise in program management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) and tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet).
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing multi-million dollar program budgets.
* Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills.

Certifications (Preferred):

* One or more is highly desirable: PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP.

jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

Turing builds and deploys production agentic AI systems for Fortune 500 enterprises across consumer goods, supply chain, manufacturing, real estate, life sciences and media. As Technical Delivery Lead for the Emerging portfolio, you will own how our GenAI engagements are architected, staffed, reviewed and delivered to production. This is a hands-on, architect-first leadership role, not a PMO or strategy role. You will lead forward-deployed engineering teams across India, the US and Latin America.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Own technical delivery across multiple concurrent client engagements, covering delivery health, technical risks, staffing and recovery when work goes off plan
* Set the technical review bar for production GenAI systems and personally review architecture across:

+ RAG and retrieval
+ Agent orchestration and multi-agent design
+ Evaluation and guardrails
+ Observability, scalability and security

* Stay hands-on: prototype critical components, debug production issues and guide teams through live client deployments
* Review the technical scope of every new engagement before signature and partner with pre-sales on estimation and delivery plans
* Build staffing plans, allocate and redeploy engineers, and hire against a high bar
* Work directly with client technical stakeholders and step into challenging engagements to reset plans
* Turn engagement work into reusable components and standards for Turing's Enterprise AI platform

  

**Requirements:**

* 12+ years in software engineering or technical consulting, including 5+ years leading AI/ML or data delivery
* **Hands-on experience building and shipping GenAI systems to production within the last 2 years (mandatory)**
* Owned technical delivery for external clients in services, consulting or client-embedded teams
* Strong working knowledge of GenAI architecture:

+ **Frameworks:** LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel
+ **LLM platforms:** Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI
+ **Retrieval and data:** vector databases, Databricks, Snowflake
+ **Production:** evaluation, guardrails, observability, LLMOps
+ **Engineering:** Python, cloud, microservices

* Experience leading distributed engineering teams

**Project Manager, Client Delivery and Account Growth**    

Aarna Systems Baner-Balewadi, Pune. In office. Full-time. 5+ years in digital marketing, including at least 1 year as a project manager.

  
   
  **The role**    

You will be the link between our clients and our delivery team. You will own client relationships from start to finish: understand what each client needs, turn that into clear tasks for the team, make sure good work goes out on time, and keep the founder updated. You will handle delivery and client management on your own.

* Act as the main point of contact for active clients, and understand their goals, requirements and what counts as success for them.
* Run a daily scrum with each team to manage the work, plan and schedule tasks, and keep delivery on track.
* Break client needs into clear briefs and tasks for developers, marketers, writers and designers, and make sure they're done to a high standard and on time.
* Review every deliverable before it goes to the client, and catch any gaps in execution, delivery or results.
* Coach team members so the quality of their work keeps improving.
* Run projects in our project management tool, keeping timelines, priorities and workloads visible.
* Give the founder a status update on all projects every day, plus a weekly report on each account's progress, risks and wins.
* Keep clients happy so they stay, through consistent, high-quality delivery and proactive communication.
* Spot chances to grow existing accounts (upsells, cross-sells, new services) and bring them forward.
* Come up with creative, original marketing ideas and campaign concepts for clients.
* Use AI tools every day to work faster on planning, briefs, reporting and content.

  
   
  **What we're looking for**    

* 5+ years of digital marketing experience, including at least 1 year as a project manager.
* A working understanding of SEO, paid ads, social media, email marketing and websites. You should be able to judge the quality of the work, not just track it.
* Excellent written and spoken English, and comfort dealing with clients in India and abroad.
* Hands-on experience with project management tools, such as Blue, ClickUp, Asana or Trello.
* Strong, practical use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.
* A track record of keeping clients and growing accounts.
* Able to work independently, stay organised across several accounts and deliver results consistently.

* Experience with GoHighLevel or other marketing automation.
* Exposure to cold outreach and lead generation campaigns.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
------------

You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.

You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.

This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterpr

At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 10+ years of experience in a client-facing, pre-sales, or consulting role within the information services, data analytics, or enterprise software industries
* Proven technical expertise in third-party risk management, supplier risk management, AML/Financial Crime compliance or enterprise risk data solutions
* Demonstrated experience in solution architecture, including end to end data workflow design and multisource integration
* Deep understanding of structured and semi-structured data and formats including JSON, XML and CSV and past experience with SQL, Python, or APIs for data integration is encouraged
* Proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with a strong understanding of GenAI. Hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows is highly desirable
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and demonstrated ability to work in a high-pressure, deadline-oriented environment
* This position offers a dynamic work environment, requiring up to 50% travel to engage with clients face-to-face, while also providing the flexibility of hybrid working

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is required as a minimum

**Responsibilities**
Serve as the functional and technical expert and design the solution to address client needs through Moody’s products and capabilities in AML/KYC and Data Management and AI solutions. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Serve as the functional and technical subject matter expert, designing solutions that address client needs using Moody’s AML, KYC, data management, and AI capabilities
* Partner with frontline sales teams and Industry Practice Leads as the pre-sales lead for Moody’s data, KYC, and third-party risk solutions
* Track evolving global and regional regulatory requirements related to third-party risk management and KYC, translating them into solution-led client strategies
* Lead client discovery sessions to define optimal solution architectures, data integration approaches, and governance frameworks
* Develop and deliver tailored solution designs, proof-of-concept demonstrations, and technical presentations that showcase Moody’s value proposition
* Lead and contribute to complex RFI and RFP responses

jobs.description:

Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.
  
  
This position is in the Financial Crime Compliance practice which is part of the Risk Advisory business group, which is one of five strategic business groups at Ankura
  
  
The Director (equivalent to Manager job level) position supports Ankura’s EMEA Financial Crime Compliance practice, which has the ambition to be the clear market leader in its field. Ankura is recognised as one of the five fasted growing consulting companies with over sixteen hundred employees across more than thirty offices globally, providing a range of advisory and expert services to the private and public sector clients.
  
  
This is a key role, operating in a fast-paced culture and will suit a candidate with the ambition and desire to grow and develop.
  
  

* Be part of a growing team with a unique opportunity to help shape the practice as it develops.
* Work within a team of world recognised experts in an established leading global consultancy.
* Work in a collaborative environment which promotes curiosity learning and communication, where our professionals have the freedom to innovate.
* Manage stakeholders on the most complex assignments.
* Gain cross discipline exposure and develop a rounded skillset across AFC investigations and compliance.
* Experience frequent client interaction including preparing and presenting results
* Be mentored by some of the best professionals in the industry.
* Experience truly supportive career development with a formal development process, training programs and an internal e-learning platform, Ankura Academy.

**Responsibilities**

* Managing day-to-day delivery of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Sanctions Programs, including investigations, model reviews, risk assessments, compliance reviews and forensic audits.
* Designing, crafting, and delivering client proposals, presentations and marketing materials.
* Preparing engagement work plans, working papers project documentation, progress reports, draft, and final reports to the highest level of quality.
* Working with clients, their legal advisors, internal and external auditors and regulatory authorise in sometimes sensitive and adversarial situations.
* Support, lead and manage the work of the assignment team comprised on internal and external experts in close intermittent and distant collaboration modes.
* Work closely with Ankura’s Data & Technology team to embed appropriate forensic technology solutions into engagement delivery.
* Plan, manage and control budget on investigation engagements.
* Monitor and manage risk through the engagement cycle. Adhere to the strictest standards of client and engagement confidentiality.
* Maintain active communication with counsel, clients, and internal team to manage expectations and ensure satisfaction.
* Manage, develop, train and mentor more junior staff on projects and assess performance for engagement and year-end review.
* Actively engage in business development activities, identifying opportunities, supporting pursuits, and winning new work alongside more senior members of the team.
* On occasion, participating in public speaking events, conferences, seminars, marketing events and client meetings.

**Requirements**

* Currently working in an FCC role in a bank or financial services firm
* Background gained in a big 4/mid-tier forensic firm.
* Proven track record of working on AFC reviews and investigations, issue management and risk asses

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent

jobs.title: Senior Director, Origination- Head of M&A
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Head of M&A Advisory
  
- Responsible for originating, winning and executing M&A and private capital advisory mandates
  
  
- Focus on converting Mashreq’s existing financing relationships into broader trusted-advisor relationships.
  
  
- Combine strong transaction execution capabilities with a highly commercial and proactive approach to origination and client development.
  
  
Key Results Area
  
- Origination & Franchise Building: Proactively identify M&A and strategic advisory opportunities across Mashreq’s client base and originate new mandates in partnership with relationship managers and sector teams.
  
  
- Trusted Advisor: Develop senior-level relationships with shareholders, boards and management teams, positioning Mashreq beyond its traditional financing role as a trusted adviser on acquisitions, disposals, capital raising and broader strategic matters.
  
  
- M&A Execution: Lead transactions end-to-end across both sell-side and buy-side mandates, including transaction strategy, valuation, process design, preparation of marketing materials, due diligence, negotiations and transaction closing.
  
  
- Equity Story & Positioning: Develop compelling equity and investment narratives around clients and assets, combining strong financial analysis with a clear articulation of strategic positioning, growth prospects and value creation opportunities.
  
  
- Buyer / Investor Access: Identify, approach and develop credibility with relevant strategic buyers, financial sponsors, sovereign investors, family offices and other institutional investors across the region and internationally.
  
  
- Private Capital: Originate and execute private capital raising mandates, including growth equity, minority investments and other strategic capital solutions.
  
  
  
Key Results Area
  
- Approximately 15+ years of high-quality M&A / investment banking advisory experience, ideally gained at a leading investment bank or advisory platform, with a demonstrable track record of executing complex transactions.
  
  
- The individual should have strong M&A technical and execution capabilities, excellent valuation and financial analysis skills, and the ability to independently develop a credible equity story and lead senior client discussions.
  
  
- Importantly, this is not intended to be a purely execution-focused role. The successful candidate should be entrepreneurial, proactive and commercially driven, with the ability to identify opportunities, originate mandates and build a business.
  
  
The candidate should bring strong judgement, executive presence and credibility with shareholders, CEOs, CFOs and sophisticated investors, together with the ability to leverage Mashreq’s existing relationships to establish a leading regional M&A advisory franchise.

jobs.description:
**Overview**
The Director – GRC Services leads the governance, risk and compliance advisory practice, holding overall accountability for service delivery, client relationships, commercial performance and people leadership across the practice. The role sets the strategic direction for GRC offerings, oversees the quality of engagements delivered to clients across regulated and unregulated sectors, and acts as the senior point of escalation on technical, commercial and risk matters. Reporting to the Executive Director – CCS, the Director translates the firm’s growth strategy into a high-performing, profitable and scalable GRC service line.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the strategy, service portfolio and go-to-market plan for the GRC Services line in alignment with the firm’s overall advisory strategy.
* Own the practice profit-and-loss, including revenue targets, utilization, margin, pricing and resource planning.
* Identify emerging regulatory, governance and risk themes (e.g. ESG, data protection, AI governance) and shape new propositions and methodologies in response. Represent the firm and the GRC practice in the market through thought leadership, industry forums, regulator engagement and speaking opportunities
* Build and maintain trusted-advisor relationships with C-suite, board and audit-committee stakeholders across client organizations.
* Lead origination and conversion of new business, including proposals, pitches, scoping and commercial negotiation.
* Drive cross-selling across other advisory and assurance service lines and manage a portfolio of strategic accounts.
* Hold ultimate delivery accountability for GRC engagements, including governance reviews, enterprise risk management, regulatory compliance, internal controls, policy frameworks and risk transformation programmes.
* Review and approve key deliverables, ensuring technical accuracy, methodological rigor and alignment with applicable standards and regulations (e.g. ISO 31000, COSO ERM, ISO 27001, Central Bank of the UAE, DFSA/DIFC, FSRA/ADGM, SCA requirements).
* Serve as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues, delivery risks and client concerns.
* Lead, mentor and develop managers and consultants, setting performance objectives and supporting career progression.
* Build the capability and capacity of the practice through recruitment, training, knowledge management and succession planning.

**Skills :-**

* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27005, and CIS Controls.
* UAE Information Assurance (UAE IA) Standards and applicable UAE Cybersecurity Council guidance.
* TDRA cybersecurity guidelines and other relevant UAE sectoral regulations.
* Cyber maturity models and quantitative cyber risk methodologies (e.g., FAIR).
* Excellent executive stakeholder management, influencing, negotiation and business-development skills.
* Strong technical command across governance, enterprise risk and regulatory compliance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including board-level reporting and presentation.

**Qualifications**
Tools Experience : -
  
  

* GRC platforms (e.g. ServiceNow GRC, RSA Archer or equivalent).
* Enterprise reporting and BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) for executive and board reporting.
* Risk and compliance management, audit and workpaper tooling.
* Standard productivity and collaboration suites (Microsoft 365 or equivalent).

**Education & Minimum Work Experience : -**

* Minimum 12 years

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. jobs.title: VCA Consulting Director, Acquiring Advisory
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Visa Consulting Director will be responsible for the growth of the Acquiring Advisory practice across CEMEA. This includes the overall strategy and successful delivery of offerings within this practice under the EMF umbrella, ensuring that it continues to grow across the region. This will require a depth of expertise in the Acquiring business, a solid understanding of the implications of the changing environment for payment service providers and the ability to design modules and set plays that will increase Visa's reputation as the leading advisor in this field. The Director will work in close cooperation with Visa's global consulting practices and with Value-Added Services, notably Visa Acceptance Solutions, and will lead a growing portfolio of Acquiring trainings, bringing a strong management consulting background and setting the standard for AI-enabled advisory delivery across the practice.
